## First release of CHIP-8 Emulator for Android

### What's included
- Full CHIP-8 / SCHIP / XO-CHIP emulation
- 6 color themes with glow and scanline effects
- ROM library with persistent storage
- Debug overlay and step mode
- Built-in benchmark tool
- Landscape mode support

### Install
Download the APK below and install on any Android 7.0+ device.
Enable "Install from unknown sources" if prompted.
